games.title: Neon Breakout
games.description: Smash through five rows of glowing bricks with a paddle you steer by mouse, touch or arrow keys. Every cleared row speeds the ball up.
instructions: Move the paddle with the mouse or touch, or with the left and right arrow keys.
Press Space, Enter or tap the playfield to launch the ball early.
Clear every brick to finish the board — you have three lives.

games.title: Star Dodger
games.description: Weave a small ship through an endless field of falling asteroids. The longer you survive, the faster they come.
instructions: Drag left and right with the mouse or your finger, or use the arrow keys.
Avoid every asteroid — a single collision ends the run.
Your score rises with survival time, so stay alive as long as you can.

games.title: Neon Serpent
games.description: The classic snake, rebuilt with a neon glow. Eat, grow, and avoid your own tail and the arena walls.
instructions: Steer with the arrow keys or WASD. On touch screens, swipe in the direction you want to go.
Each glowing orb adds 10 points and makes the serpent longer and slightly faster.
Running into a wall or into your own body ends the run.

games.title: Reflex Rush
games.description: A glowing target appears and starts shrinking away. Tap it before time runs out — three misses ends the run.
instructions: Click or tap the glowing circle before its timer runs out.
Faster reactions and a fuller timer ring award more points.
Three misses end the run.

games.title: Pixel Pong
games.description: A tight one-on-one pong match against a computer paddle. First to seven points takes the match.
instructions: Move your green paddle with the mouse, your finger, or the up and down arrow keys.
Hitting the ball near the edge of the paddle angles the return more sharply.
First player to seven points wins the match.

games.title: Mind Match
games.description: A four-by-four memory board. Flip two tiles at a time, remember what you saw, and clear all eight pairs in as few moves as possible.
instructions: Click or tap a card to reveal its symbol.
Flip a second card — if the symbols match, both stay face-up.
Clear all eight pairs. Fewer moves means a better finish.
